Our common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “FHN.” At December 31, 2025, we had total consolidated assets of $84 billion. We provide commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services principally through our wholly-owned subsidiary, First Horizon Bank.
